seoTitle: How to Create a Survey in Jotform Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to design and publish an online survey in Jotform in 2026, using Likert scales, NPS fields, and branded themes to collect feedback.
intro: Collecting structured feedback requires more than a basic contact form, and Jotform includes purpose-built survey fields like Likert scales and Net Promoter Score inputs. This guide covers starting a survey project, adding specialized feedback fields, and publishing it with a shareable link or QR code.

steps.heading: Start a new survey project
steps.body: Open your account workspace, click Create Form, and choose between starting from scratch or using a survey template layout.

steps.heading: Add core survey fields
steps.body: Use the sidebar to drag and drop standard survey fields onto your canvas.

steps.heading: Add advanced feedback blocks
steps.body: Include Input Tables, Net Promoter Score fields, or Likert scale options for more structured feedback collection.

steps.heading: Match your branding
steps.body: Use the Form Designer panel to adjust colors and fonts so the survey matches your brand identity.

steps.heading: Configure and publish
steps.body: Set up custom thank-you page logic in Settings, then use the Publish tab to copy a sharing link or generate a QR code, and review feedback live in Jotform Tables.

faq.question: Does Jotform support Net Promoter Score questions?
faq.answer: Yes, NPS fields are available as one of the specialized survey blocks you can add to your form.

faq.question: Can I generate a QR code for my survey?
faq.answer: Yes, the Publish tab lets you generate a QR code in addition to a direct sharing link.

faq.question: Where do I see survey responses after people fill it out?
faq.answer: Responses appear live inside Jotform Tables, where you can review collected feedback metrics.

faq.question: Can I start from a survey template instead of building from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes, Jotform offers survey template layouts you can choose from when creating a new form.
